summary: This informational document evaluates existing IETF routing protocols against the routing requirements of an Automatically Switched Optical Network (ASON) as defined by ITU-T. It builds on the Generalized MPLS suite, which controls technologies such as SONET/SDH and optical transport networks.

eli5.summary: A company wants to know whether existing road maps work for a new kind of light-based highway. This document checks them against the list of things the highway needs.
